headline_marked: HSC exams: [[Wrong question papers distributed]] in Narsingdi and Gaibandha
headline: HSC exams: Wrong question papers distributed in Narsingdi and Gaibandha
summary: Students in two districts faced confusion and distress as they were given incorrect question papers for their Higher Secondary Certificate exams.
details: Students in Narsingdi and Gaibandha districts reported that they were given the wrong question papers during their HSC examinations.
In Gaibandha, it was reported that 25 candidates took the exam using the incorrect question papers, leading to significant confusion among the students.
Similar allegations of wrong question paper distribution have emerged from Narsingdi, adding to the concerns regarding the administration of the national exams.
The incidents have caused distress for students who spent hours preparing for specific subjects, only to find the wrong questions on their desks.
Education authorities are expected to investigate these lapses to ensure that affected students are not disadvantaged in their final results.
caption:
Imagine spending months studying for an exam, only to be handed the wrong question paper on the day.

Students in Narsingdi and Gaibandha districts reported that they were given the wrong question papers during their HSC examinations.

In Gaibandha, it was reported that 25 candidates took the exam using the incorrect question papers, leading to significant confusion among the students.

Similar allegations of wrong question paper distribution have emerged from Narsingdi, adding to the concerns regarding the administration of the national exams.

The incidents have caused distress for students who spent hours preparing for specific subjects, only to find the wrong questions on their desks.

Education authorities are expected to investigate these lapses to ensure that affected students are not disadvantaged in their final results.

#HSC #Education #Bangladesh #ExamCrisis #Narsingdi #Gaibandha
